title: Chapter 41
content:
Chapter 41

Looking at the personal attribute panel, Zhongyu Vientiane's area about cultivation. The first thing that appears above is not about the exercises of cultivation, but an introduction.

The emperor, enjoying the wealth and honor of the world, holds the ultimate power, and has reached the extreme of human beings. If you can get the method of cultivation again, and use the power of the whole country to search for the treasures of heaven and earth, and gather the wisdom of everyone to explore the Dao, it will definitely get out of hand.

Cultivation is successful, and the life span is endless, the power shakes the heavens and the earth, the slightest thought, the earth trembles, and the disaster is endless.

That's why the sky is jealous, all living beings are jealous, cultivators are afraid of it, and all things attack it. All emperors who practiced the technique of longevity were first punished by heaven, then suffered national turmoil, and then suffered robbery by monks, and experienced the resentment of all things.

Ordinary Dharma emperors can’t practice, and extra-fang Dharma conflicts with the emperor’s dragon energy. Forcible practice will inevitably lead to harm. Therefore, it is impossible to do it with non-special methods, but there are great wisdom in the world, with great perseverance. Great opportunity, great luck, created the power of the emperor, cultivated it to the extreme in the world, dominated all living beings, and climbed to the top, no one can face it.

However, the emperor's practice is the envy of all beings and all beings, so there will be disasters when practicing this practice. At that time, heaven and earth will regard it as an enemy, and all spirits will regard it as a natural enemy. Atmospheric luck, unavoidable.

Seeing such a long introduction, Zhong Yu's heart rolled for a while, and he finally understood why the previous system said it would decide his future life. If he chooses the path of cultivation, he is very likely to die without a place to be buried, and even there is no trace of his existence in this world, and he will be forcibly erased by the powerhouses of heaven and earth.

However, if he did not choose this path, even if he used the power of the whole country to collect treasures from heaven and earth, in order to prolong his lifespan, he would also increase his time for several decades at most. After more than 100 years, he is still a handful of loess.

At that time, after reincarnation, the one who has experienced the red dust is rolling. Continue to polish your soul, is your self really you at that time? Even if the most fundamental true spirit is a person, but the container that holds the true spirit, that is, the human soul, has been completely replaced by another person and washed again. Is that really the original self? Rather, it's a second personality.

So, do you have any other options? Having already tasted the taste of power, I can no longer let go of this feeling of having the power to kill all living beings. It is like a person taking drugs. Once they come into contact with them, they can no longer be forgotten, and they can only continue to sink.

Therefore, Zhong Yu just struggled a little in his heart, and chose to practice without hesitation.

"System, I have decided, I still want to practice this exercise, and show me the content of this exercise!" Zhong Yu's voice was decisive and heavy, but there was no delay.

"The host chooses the road, and it is determined to be the road of the emperor. The choice is successful, and the permission is being opened." The system's voice was slightly rushed, and Zhong Yu's choice could actually make this situation happen to him who has no feelings.

"The opening is complete, the exercises have been displayed, and the host can view it in the training template."

Hearing the system's voice, Zhong Yu hurriedly looked at the training template in front of him and checked the information about the exercises.

Name of the exercises: Tianyi Emperor Gong.

Introduction: The Great Dao is fifty, Tianyan is four-nine, escape to get one, Tianyi Emperor Gong, as the name suggests, is to intercept this line of vitality and not be observed by heaven and earth. With this Dao machine, all things evolve, and the root of all beings in the heaven and earth is captured, making up for one's own body, and returning to one.

Specific cultivation: that is, the incense of all living beings, gather the merits and virtues of human beings, condense the luck of the country, and become the supreme heaven.

Seeing such a powerful passage, Zhong Yu took a deep breath, his heart was full of excitement, and infinite pride was ignited. He had guessed before that this kind of exercise must be extremely powerful, but he didn't expect it to be like this.

I have been guessing before, what exactly is luck? Why can so many things be exchanged? Could it be that the system originally existed, or that he obtained it on this continent, but he was unable to detect it with his own ability, and was converted by the system into what he needed.

Now I finally understand that the so-called luck is the origin of a world. It is what this world uses to create all beings and all things and keep the world running. It can be said to be precious and unusual.

Even for a world, it is extremely difficult to produce some origins.

Usually, a cycle of heaven and earth can only harvest one ten thousandth of the original luck of the world.

The so-called reincarnation of heaven and earth is a plot that people often say. When the world accumulates to a certain extent, a plot will be organized to develop, and some so-called children of destiny, that is, the protagonist, will come to experience calamity.

Through the calamity emanating from the sky and the earth, the impurities in his body are removed at one time, so that he can produce a trace of evolution. Then, through the protagonist's hand, he will trigger the changes in the general trend of the world, so as to harvest the fruits that have grown in his body, that is, luck.

Therefore, those protagonists often represent the will of God, and everything they do is extremely smooth. Even if there is some tempering, it is just that the world has been trying to harvest more luck.

Having said so much, I am afraid that many people have not yet understood what Qi Luck is. In fact, to put it bluntly, Qi Luck is a collection of consciousness, which is what people often call humanity.

Of course, it is not only humane, but there are also some other manifestations. Humans produce humanism, demons produce demons, demons produce demons, even gods produce gods, and immortals produce immortals. As long as there are living beings with a certain number of them, they can produce that kind of aggregate of consciousness.

So what is the relationship between these Taos and the will of heaven and earth? The will of heaven and earth absorbs and exhales void energy from the periphery of the world, but it itself can eat like a human mouth but cannot digest it.

Then a stomach is needed to digest, so various aggregates of consciousness are produced. For some unknown reason, this aggregate can absorb those void energies.

But it itself cannot be directly contacted, so it can only be absorbed by the will of heaven and earth. And the will of heaven and earth needs the luck extracted from these void energies to absorb and purify and improve one's personality.

So the two form a symbiotic relationship, but the instinct of any creature does not allow its own food to escape.

Therefore, the aggregate of consciousness refuses to give up the final form of the energy of the void that it has extracted. The will of heaven and earth has to figure out a way to take it out of his mouth, so the plot and the catastrophe of heaven and earth appear. .

After all, those aggregates of consciousness are generated by various spirits, as long as they disturb the social stability of the race that generated it, provoke various conflicts, and stimulate its foundation.

Let it fluctuate for a period of time, and there will be a gap, which can allow the will of heaven and earth to take advantage of the emptiness and plunder the luck it has extracted to supplement itself.

This trick has been tried and tested, and those consciousness aggregates, because they are the thoughts of various spirits, are said to be aggregated together. Incomparably complicated and without order, apart from the original instinct, there is no wisdom that can resist these calculations.

Of course, those wills of heaven and earth will not go too far. After all, they are still its refining machines. If they are completely broken, then the will of heaven and earth will be finished, and they will slowly decline until they are completely wiped out.
